items.title: Kubernetes Changed Block Tracking API - Beta Differences
items.blurb: Changed Block Tracking (CBT) support for CSI drivers shipped as Alpha in September 2025. With the March 2026 v1.0.0 release of the external-snapshot-metadata project, the feature moved to Beta .

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Memory QoS Graduates to Beta
items.blurb: Memory QoS has graduated to Beta in Kubernetes v1.37 and is now enabled by default. On Linux nodes running cgroup v2, the feature uses the memory controller to give the kernel better guidance on how to treat container memory.
